capabilities: Filter [!question] callouts by tag, parent topic, creation date and answer status
Browse and search questions in a right-sidebar panel and compile them into a templated note
Split a note into atomic notes along headings with parent links and renumbered footnotes
Batch-create notes from a name list or a numbered series using a template
Insert PDF page footnotes from a sources section, falling back to a standard footnote
extras: Some interface terms and examples are in German (heute, Aufgabe, Übungsblatt, Quellen); installation is manual or built from source.
problem: Academic note-taking in Obsidian needs manual work to collect open questions, break long notes into atomic ones, and cite PDF pages.

relations.evidence: replacing extracted text with a # Unterthemen Dataview block

summary: Academic note toolkit: filters [!question] callouts into a sidebar, splits notes into atomic notes, batch-creates from templates, and adds PDF page footnotes.
